limitations: Ordinal likelihood and impact scores — not statistical probabilities.
Risk register supports governance triage, not regulatory attestation.

risks.risk_title: Dead WinINET localhost proxy blocks browser access
risks.risk_scenario: ProxyServer points to localhost port with no listener; browsers fail while ICMP may succeed.
risks.risk_description: Stale localhost WinINET proxy blocks browser and SSO flows while ping may still succeed.
risks.remediation_action: Preview proxy-disable with typed confirmation and rollback snapshot
risks.recommended_action: Preview proxy-disable with typed confirmation and rollback snapshot
risks.business_explanation: Users cannot reach SaaS and SSO sites; helpdesk volume rises while root cause appears as network outage.

risks.risk_title: Unknown localhost proxy listener without writer attribution
risks.risk_scenario: Listener present on proxy port; registry writer unknown without Sysmon E13.
risks.risk_description: Unattributed localhost proxy listener increases triage uncertainty and delays safe remediation.
risks.recommended_action: Collect Sysmon E13 or Procmon evidence before process action
risks.business_explanation: Without writer attribution, operations may reset network stacks blindly, increasing repeat incidents.

risks.risk_title: TLS path mismatch — possible interception context
risks.risk_scenario: Proxied TLS chain differs from direct path; requires investigation with limitations.
risks.risk_description: TLS path contrast suggests investigation context; not confirmed interception.
risks.remediation_action: Document path delta; escalate with evidence tier — not confirmed MITM
risks.recommended_action: Route to cyber risk triage with limitations; do not label as confirmed MITM
risks.business_explanation: Certificate path anomalies can affect regulated workflows and customer trust if miscommunicated.
limitations: POSSIBLE_MITM_RISK is triage — not confirmed interception.
